versions.content: On entering sub-state COMM_FULL_COM_NETWORK_REQUESTED from COMM_NO_COM_REQUEST_PENDING and EcuM module has indicated a wake-up by ComM_EcuM_WakeUpIndication(<channel>) (see SWS_ComM_00275) or by ComM_EcuM_PNCWakeUpIndication(<PNC>) (see SWS_ComM_91001), the ComM module shall request Nm_PassiveStartup(<channel>) from the Network Management. If the indicated ComM channel is a managed channel, the ComM module shall request Nm_PassiveStartup(<referencing managing channel>) (see ECUC_ComM_00893) from the Network Management.
